text.aria-label: Title text 'A real labelled load-shift event ended about 3 days before the refit, at one signed-MW Primary. Labelled depth 26 points of capacity; the refit trained on metered targets. Line: median. Dark band: 50% interval; light band: 90% interval. Black: actual. Dashed: the median after training on NRA-corrected targets.'
text.tspan: A real labelled load-shift event ended about 3 days before the refit, at one signed-MW Primary.
Labelled depth 26 points of capacity; the refit trained on metered targets.
Line: median. Dark band: 50% interval; light band: 90% interval. Black: actual. Dashed: the median after training on NRA-corrected targets.
